result: Atomicity hardening is present and requested tests/build pass. Backup creation deletes moved destination if metadata insertion fails; rename/delete compensate metadata failures; retention uses tombstones and restores the file if metadata deletion fails. Saves UI is fully wired to BackupMetadata with role propagation, metadata/hash display, download, owner-only rename/delete/restore, confirmations, and {confirm:true} restore payload. API routes retain CSRF/audit integration, owner checks, stopped guards, integrity/path validation, and scheduled skip while running. Minor residual: if physical deletion of a retention tombstone fails after metadata deletion, an untracked tombstone remains on disk; no live integration test exercises these failure paths.

evidence.outcome: Passed; Vite production build completed with existing SignalR Rollup warnings.
Create compensates destination deletion when metadata insert fails.
Rename/delete compensate filesystem changes if metadata update/delete fails.
Retention tombstones restore original path if metadata deletion fails; failed physical tombstone deletion leaves recoverable unindexed file.
Saves receives role, renders metadata/hash/length/source/time, wires download and owner-only rename/delete/restore, confirms destructive actions, sends {confirm:true}.
Backup routes retain CSRF/audit, explicit restore confirmation, owner enforcement, and error/guard mappings.

next_slice.summary: Save/backup QA is complete. Optional follow-up: failure-injection/integration tests and cleanup of untracked prune tombstones after failed physical deletion.
